LanguageDescription: Use the device language. Your choice also applies to the Mod Menu the next time you open the game.
ImportPackageWarning: A mod runs code inside the game: only install packages from people you trust.
ImportPackageFormat: The package is a .bl, .bmod or .zip with manifest.json and the content/ folder.
ReorderHint: Hold and drag within the same group. The first enabled package loads first.
PackagesEmpty: No packages. Get one from Explore or import a .bmod.
ThemeEffectsDescription: Each scene has its own effects: leaves and swaying cards in the Forest, rain and wet shine in the Ocean, bubbles in the Lake and snow in the Snow scene. Turn off to keep the background still.
EnableOnInstallDescription: Newly installed packages are enabled on the next launch.
ShowErrorsInGameDescription: When a mod fails, the log appears on screen as well as in logcat.
DetailedLogDescription: The session log (logs/ folder) includes every table, hook and type registered by the core. When off, it keeps the summary and mod messages.
FileCommandChannelDescription: Accepts commands through adb during gameplay. For development only.
ModMenuDescription: The bunny button in game: powers, items, NPCs and buffs. When off, powers from the previous session stay disabled.
JsEditorDescription: Runs code in game: JavaScript with QuickJS on, C# always (with a C# mod enabled), and shows the mods' log. The floating icon is available from the title screen, with or without the Mod Menu.
RestartDescription: Closes and reopens the game, reloading mods from the folder (in the Mod Menu and editor).
QuickJsDescription: The JavaScript engine. Off, JS mods do not load and the game starts without it; C# mods still load.
DiagnosticsDescription: Did the game close, freeze or show an error? Open the report and send the text (Copy) or a screenshot to the Bunny Loader or mod maintainer.
SceneDescription: The launcher background. The sky follows your phone's clock; automatic mode changes the scene on each launch.
QuickStartDescription: The Re-Logic logo disappears when loading finishes, and the game enters the world below directly. Also applies when restarting from the Mod Menu.
NoSavedCharacters: No saved characters yet. Create one in game; until then, the game stops at the title screen.
ProfileHint: Tap the photo or name to change
ImportSavesDescription: %1$s world(s) and %2$s character(s) saved. Choose the .wld or .plr; Bunny Loader files for the same save (.wld.bl, .wld.tiles.bl...) can be included.
ImportedHint: It now appears in the game list and Quick start.
CloseGameBeforeImport: Close the game first: an open game may overwrite the save.
ImportNoOverwrite: Nothing is overwritten: if a %1$s with the same file name exists, the imported file gets _2.
ImportWorldModsHint: Mod blocks, walls and NPCs only appear with the same mods enabled. Also choose the world's .wld.bl, .wld.tiles.bl and .wld.walls.bl files, if present.
JourneyWorldsNeedJourneyCharacters: Journey worlds only open with Journey characters.
ImportCharacterModsHint: Mod items only appear with the same mods enabled. Also choose the character's .plr.bl file, if present.
ImportTrustWarning: Only open saves from people you trust.
LicenseSummary: Source available for noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). Terraria, Unity, the font and each mod have their own owners and licenses.
TextNotInApk: The text was not included in the APK.
PackageMissingLicense: The package does not include the license text (license.md).
ModUpdatesAvailable: New versions of your installed mods are available.
ModUpdatesAllDone: All up to date. The new versions take effect the next time the game opens.
SuperJumpDescription: Jump high with no fall damage
InfiniteJumpsDescription: Tap in midair to jump again
InfiniteMinionsDescription: Summon as many as you want
EnemiesDescription: Stop spawns or remove them all
MapTeleportDescription: Hold for 1 s on the fullscreen map
RevealMapDescription: The whole world on the map
HardmodeDescription: Like defeating the Wall of Flesh
StopBiomeSpreadDescription: Stop Corruption, Crimson and Hallow spread
BloodMoonDescription: Switch to night if it is day
SolarEclipseDescription: Switch to day if it is night
ReadingGameCatalog: Reading the game catalog in your game language...
ItemClassesMissing: The game did not provide item classes. "All items" still shows the full list.
RestartGameDescription: The game closes and reopens, reloading mods from the folder.
RestartGameUnsavedWarning: The game closes and reopens, reloading mods from the folder. Unsaved progress in this world will be lost unless you save now.
RestartNoResponse: The game did not respond. Restarting without saving...
EditorHelp: Code runs on the game thread, like a hook. Main, ID and player (your character) are ready. print(...) writes to chat; bl.log(...) writes to the log (also shown here). let/const last only for one execution; use var or globalThis.x to keep values between runs.
EditorCsHelp: C# code is compiled on the phone (the first run takes a few seconds) and runs on the game thread, like a hook. An expression shows its value: player.statLife = 500. Terraria, Terraria.ID, Microsoft.Xna.Framework and the loaded C# mods are open; player is your character and print(...) writes to chat. C# needs at least one C# mod enabled.
ImportReplaceHint: If the mod is already installed (same uid), the app asks before replacing it.
SameVersionReinstall: Same version: updating reinstalls the mod.
FileOlderThanInstalled: The file is older than the installed mod.
DiscordDescription: News, help with mods and the Bunny Loader community.
MostDownloadedDescription: The most downloaded in the catalog.
TerrariaRequiredDescription: To play, Terraria must be installed on this phone. Install it from the Play Store, then come back.
LanguageConfirmDescription: Is this your language? Tap another one to change it. You can also change it later in Settings.
SourceLocationsDescription: The default folder and all added locations are scanned together.
FolderPermissionFailed: Could not keep access to this folder.
OpenFolderFailed: Could not open the folder. Use a file manager supporting Android documents.
NoProjects: No projects. Create your first mod.
NoProjectsInLanguage: No projects in this language yet.
WaitForImport: Wait for the import to finish before installing the project.
ModBuiltAndInstalled: %1$s built and installed. Reopen the game to load it.
Author: Author
